title: Mobile application (lichen-mobile)
description:
Mobile application for LICHEN using Flutter.

Features:
- CoAP client for node communication over BLE or local WiFi
- Contact management with TOFU key pinning
- Message composition and history
- Waypoint management with native maps
- Node status and diagnostics
- Background service for notifications
- iOS and Android support

Communication modes:
- BLE GATT to local LICHEN node
- IPv6+CoAP over local network if node has WiFi backhaul

Depends on Local Client Interface (Phase 6) being defined.
